subject: Consolidated onboarding: portal-first policy, single-line CSV backstop and subject token
messages:
From: Eliot Park <eliot.park@smartledger.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: susan@acmecorp.com
Date: 2027-07-25T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice submission options for SmartLedger (portal vs email)

Hi Vanessa,

Quick question as we're finishing Redwood onboarding: our ERP can push invoices to an API or export a single-line CSV per invoice and we can always attach the legacy PDF. Is Redwood mandating portal-only submissions for all vendors, or is an email fallback acceptable? If email fallback is allowed, what subject or field conventions do you need so your AP system can auto-ingest without manual touch?

Also: we sometimes have a single invoice that covers multiple internal POs. How should we represent that in a single-line CSV envelope?

Thanks — appreciate the guidance.

Eliot Park
AP Operations, SmartLedger Inc
eliot.park@smartledger.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: none (will send sample CSV/PDF on request)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Eliot Park <eliot.park@smartledger.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-25T13:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice submission options for SmartLedger (portal vs email)

Hi Eliot — thanks for reaching out and welcome. Short answer: portal-first, but we support a strict email backstop for vendors who can't integrate right away. Below is the minimal email fallback protocol we use; following this exactly ensures automated ingestion and avoids manual tickets.

1) Policy: portal-first. Email fallback ok for pilot / legacy ERP on-ramps but subject to limits (rate, format). We expect vendors to move to portal or SFTP within 60 days.

2) Email subject token (required for fallback):
   INVOICE:{VendorID}:{YYYYMMDD}:{InvoiceNumber}
   Example: INVOICE:SL-2043:20270724:INV-9832

3) Envelope model (single-line CSV):
   - We ask for exactly one CSV row per email that acts as the envelope/meta record. If your ERP can only emit a single-line summary, that's OK. The CSV header we expect (columns): VendorID, RedwoodPO, InvoiceNumber, InvoiceDate, Currency, Amount, LineCount, PDF_SHA256
   - LineCount should be the number of invoice detail lines inside the attached PDF (if you attach a multi-line PDF). If you truly only have one summary line, set LineCount=1.
   - PDF_SHA256: optional but strongly preferred — hex-encoded SHA256 checksum of the attached PDF to guarantee idempotency on replays.

   Sample CSV header and single row (comma-delimited):
   VendorID,RedwoodPO,InvoiceNumber,InvoiceDate,Currency,Amount,LineCount,PDF_SHA256
   SL-2043,PO-998,INV-9832,2027-07-24,USD,14250.00,1,3b1f9a1a9f5b2e6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0

4) Multi-PO invoices: preferred path is portal or SFTP manifest. If you must use email fallback, send one envelope per PO (i.e., split the invoice into multiple envelopes) or include a manifest PDF where each PO line is explicit and LineCount matches total detail lines. We will not accept a single CSV row that ambiguously claims multiple PO references without a manifest PDF.

5) Attachments: name them using the invoice subject token, e.g. INV-9832_SL-2043_20270724.pdf; include the matching single-line CSV as sample_singleline.csv.

6) Acks and idempotency: We acknowledge accepted envelopes within ~48 hours. We use the tuple (VendorID, InvoiceNumber, PDF_SHA256) to dedupe re-submits — including the checksum avoids duplicates.

7) Onboarding form and exceptions: Please complete the attached vendor_onboarding_form.pdf and return it. Jordan will schedule a 30-min mapping call to capture PO patterns and SFTP options.

I've attached a sample CSV and a short checklist. CC'ing Jordan (partner ops) to coordinate the pilot and Marissa (billing) for PO mapping questions.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Supplier Onboarding | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0123

Attachments: sample_singleline.csv (CSV), vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF)

From: Eliot Park <eliot.park@smartledger.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: susan@acmecorp.com
Date: 2027-07-26T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice submission options for SmartLedger (portal vs email)

Vanessa — thanks, that's very clear and the token/CSV example helps. A couple clarifications:

- Our downstream process typically issues one invoice PDF that references 3 POs (PO-998, PO-1001, PO-1005). In the legacy flow we usually produce a single PDF and a single summary row. Splitting at source is possible but will require a short code change on our side.

- If we include a manifest PDF listing the PO lines, will the PDF_SHA256 + LineCount be sufficient for your ingestion to match multiple POs to a single invoice on your side?

Attaching a sample PDF (sample_invoice.pdf) and the single-line CSV we can produce right now (sample_singleline.csv). Can you confirm whether we should split now or if a manifest PDF is acceptable for the pilot?

Appreciate the quick turn.

Eliot

Attachments: sample_invoice.pdf (PDF), sample_singleline.csv (CSV)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Eliot Park <eliot.park@smartledger.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-27T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice submission options for SmartLedger (portal vs email)

Eliot — good questions and thanks for the samples. We checked the PDF and the envelope looks workable for an initial pilot with two practical conditions:

1) For pilot acceptance (30 days): you may send a single invoice PDF that references multiple POs provided the attached PDF is the canonical source of truth and the CSV envelope includes the PDF_SHA256 and an accurate LineCount. Our ingest will parse the manifest PDF and map lines to POs.

2) Production requirement: within 60 days we ask that either (A) you move to portal/SFTP batch with explicit manifest rows (preferred), or (B) send split envelopes per-PO for faster automated matching. The portal/SFTP option avoids parsing PDFs and reduces errors.

Next steps I propose: Jordan will book a 30-minute mapping call for Thursday 7/29 to walk your AP team through the checksum and PO mapping expectations and to validate SFTP/portal options. Please complete and return vendor_onboarding_form.pdf before the call so we can provision anything needed.

If that works I'll mark the vendor onboarding pilot as 'portal-first: accepted for email backstop during 30-day pilot' and share the pilot checklist with Marissa for billing.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.
Vanessa

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF)
